messages:
Maya: quick heads-upwe pushed the launch-post series for Project Nebula at 08:30 PT. morning traffic looks noisy.
Omar: saw it. overall visits up +180% vs baseline but dashboard shows Lead Rate down ~25%.
Priya: early suspicion: UTM tag inconsistency from partner syndication. a few top referrers are coming in with utm_source=partner and utm_source=partner_1 (same org).
Maya: ugh. that will fragment attribution and make our benchmark compare misleading.
DataBot: nightly_kpi_digest completed cards refreshed: sessions, leads, demo_requests, webinar_regs.
Omar: can we add an "Attribution Comparison" strip to the KPI board? side-by-side last_touch_7d vs position_based_30d so stakeholders see lift differences.
Priya: yes. also asking for a small crosswalk mapping external referrers -> canonical_partner_name before attribution runs. I can table a mapping file.
Sahil: tagging @Priya re: contact timing can we surface median time_to_first_contact (TTFC) by crm_source and cohort (last 14d vs prev 14d)? need to prove if routing lag is correlated with lower demo conversions.
Priya: will add TTFC_card. plan: median + IQR + 95pctile.
Maya: also want a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for the weekly KPI deck: summarize why lead rate dropped and what we're doing (tag normalization, dual-attrib view, TTFC). keep it 3 bullets.
Omar: on messaging iteration: A/B test for hero copy still running. early CTR shows copy B winning on CTR but not on demo requests. think landing copy mismatch to CTA intent.
Priya: could be quality vs quantity. send me sample leads from copy A and B, I'll run a quick funnel-quality check.
Sahil: small helper SQL for canonicalizing utm_source if useful:
```
CASE
  WHEN utm_source LIKE '%partner%' THEN 'partner'
  WHEN utm_source IN ('newsletter','email') THEN 'email'
  ELSE utm_source
END as canonical_source
```
Maya: nice. also FYI GA4 pipeline had a processing delay this morning (ingest lag ~45m) so some real-time cards underreport until backfill.
DataBot: alert: GA4_backfill_in_progress estimated backlog 35k events.
Omar: ok note that in the deck so PMs don't freak out.
Priya: ETA for dashboard changes? Attribution strip + mapping + TTFC card I can have PR by tomorrow noon.
Maya: perfect. who will write the 3-bullet benchmark narrative? I can draft, Omar + Priya review.
Sahil: I'll prepare the sampling query for copy A/B lead quality and schedule a quick pass with Priya.
Maya: action list: Priya mapping + TTFC card, Omar review narrative + slide, Sahil lead-sample query, DataBot to flag when GA4 backfill completes. sync tomorrow 10:30 PT for KPI review. thanks :raised_hands:
